findings.finding: 3D Investment Partners, which holds 4,862,047 shares (9.9%), began an 'accelerated share disposal' on 2026-09-25. It is now below 10%, so further sales no longer need a two-day Form 4, and it can sell again in the 10-01 session. That holding is about 15 days of the stock's 20-day median dollar volume at spot.
findings.mechanism_in_window: It lands inside the window because the holder has already started selling and needs no further document to keep going. Nothing prevents a sale in the 10-01 session (US or Tokyo), and since it dropped under 10% a sale would surface only through a 13D/A on a 1% change, not a Form 4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior 3D disposal appears in the filings the baseline lists. The drop cluster after it was filed (09-29 -8.57%, 09-30 -11.2%, both continuations) is consistent with ongoing supply but does not prove it.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken one disclosed block (640k at $2.70) and the readout. It has not taken the remaining 4.86M shares from a holder that has already shown it will sell below where the stock traded a week ago. If the market held the whole overhang, today's leg would have come on heavy volume. Instead it came on ordinary volume, which looks like a steady seller leaning on a thin book. Tempered because 456,637 of the 640k sold may sit with the counterparty as a swap hedge, not as stock for resale.
findings.independence: The Form 4 filed the same day records the same sale and the 'formerly 10% owner' status (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1226616/000121390026104739/xslF345X06/ownership.xml). It comes from the same filer, so it adds no independent evidence.
